verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API exposes transactions, cards, users, and JIT funding endpoints that could underpin balance and ledger data, but the evidence pack has no mention of settlement reporting, clearing reconciliation, or penny-accurate ledger reconciliation features that a finance lead would need. missing for 10: settlement reporting/reconciliation docs, authorization-to-clearing ledger tie-out, real-time balance dashboard for finance stakeholders, and any reconciliation-to-the-penny guarantee.
